retraction.reason: Retracted in M30a-2 and re-filed as the tenure "amilcar-cabral-paigc-1956": who led a body is an office somebody held and not a link between two actors, because a relation's id is from--to--type and one person may lead one body more than once. The type "led" is deprecated and no active relation may take it; nothing this record claimed was changed in the move.

note: Founder, and its leader until he was killed in January 1973.
